decisive_finding.cause: Ordinary cleanup failure returns before IsolationLease changes its disposition. FixtureScheduler reinserts that run, so a retained cleanup failure remains observably Active instead of RecoveryRequired. On macOS and Linux this is the guaranteed result of the fail-closed Unsupported deletion branch, and the current test exercises only explicit recover(), bypassing the product path under review.

review_verification.result: green tests do not exercise ordinary finish cleanup failure state

root_disposition.claim_ceiling: The candidate proves that final name-only deletion is removed and unrelated replacement identities are retained. It does not yet prove truthful recovery-state reporting or successful cleanup on macOS, Linux, Windows, or an unexecuted FreeBSD host.

corrective_action: Make every retained cleanup failure transition to RecoveryRequired before reinsertion, add ordinary finish/finish_observed and repeated recovery controls that cannot be satisfied through explicit recover() alone, regenerate an exact WorkerResult-v1, and independently re-review before root expectation reconciliation.
no_claim_statement: This decision does not claim fixture product completion, evaluation completion, readiness, release, or goal completion.
